@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix : <http://www.example.org/ontology#> .

<http://www.example.org/ontology/hospital-story-1> a owl:Ontology ;
    rdfs:label "Hospital Story Ontology" ;
    rdfs:comment "An ontology representing hospital staff, unions, evaluations, articles, and seminars based on the provided story." .

#################################################################
# Classes
#################################################################
:Person a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Person" ; rdfs:comment "A human being involved in the hospital context." .
:Nurse a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Nurse" ; rdfs:comment "A person who is a nurse." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:Doctor a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Doctor" ; rdfs:comment "A person who is a doctor." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:NursingAssistant a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Nursing Assistant" ; rdfs:comment "A person who is a nursing assistant." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Nurse .
:CertifiedNurse a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Certified Nurse" ; rdfs:comment "A nurse who is certified." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Nurse .
:Degree a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Degree" ; rdfs:comment "A degree awarded to a person." .
:Hospital a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Hospital" ; rdfs:comment "A medical institution." .
:City a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "City" ; rdfs:comment "A city where hospitals are located." .
:Country a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Country" ; rdfs:comment "A country where cities are located." .
:Union a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Union" ; rdfs:comment "A union organizing hospital staff." .
:UnionMembership a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Union Membership" ; rdfs:comment "A reified membership of a person in a union at a specific time and role." .
:UnionRole a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Union Role" ; rdfs:comment "A role a person can have within a union." .
:Employee a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Employee" ; rdfs:comment "A person employed by a hospital." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Person .
:Evaluation a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Evaluation" ; rdfs:comment "A written evaluation by a doctor for an employee." .
:Article a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Article" ; rdfs:comment "A research article." .
:ArticleCollection a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Article Collection" ; rdfs:comment "A collection of research articles." .
:Book a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Book" ; rdfs:comment "A book version of an article collection." ; rdfs:subClassOf :ArticleCollection .
:CD a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "CD" ; rdfs:comment "A CD version of an article collection." ; rdfs:subClassOf :ArticleCollection .
:Seminar a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Seminar" ; rdfs:comment "A seminar where articles are presented." .
:SeminarPresentation a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Seminar Presentation" ; rdfs:comment "A reified event of presenting an article in a seminar." .

#################################################################
# Disjointness
#################################################################
:Nurse owl:disjointWith :Doctor .
:Book owl:disjointWith :CD .
:ArticleCollection owl:disjointUnionOf ( :Book :CD ) .

#################################################################
# Object Properties and Inverses
#################################################################
:hasDegree a owl:ObjectProperty , owl:FunctionalProperty ; rdfs:label "has degree" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to a degree they have." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :Degree ; owl:inverseOf :degreeOf .
:degreeOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "degree of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasDegree; relates a degree to its holder." ; rdfs:domain :Degree ; rdfs:range :Person ; owl:inverseOf :hasDegree .

:studiedFor a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "studied for" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to a degree they studied for." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :Degree ; owl:inverseOf :studiedBy .
:studiedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "studied by" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of studiedFor; relates a degree to the person who studied for it." ; rdfs:domain :Degree ; rdfs:range :Person ; owl:inverseOf :studiedFor .

:employedAt a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "employed at" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to a hospital where they are employed." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :Hospital ; owl:inverseOf :hasEmployee .
:hasEmployee a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has employee" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of employedAt; relates a hospital to its employees." ; rdfs:domain :Hospital ; rdfs:range :Person ; owl:inverseOf :employedAt .

:locatedInCity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "located in city" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a hospital to a city." ; rdfs:domain :Hospital ; rdfs:range :City ; owl:inverseOf :hasHospital .
:hasHospital a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has hospital" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of locatedInCity; relates a city to its hospitals." ; rdfs:domain :City ; rdfs:range :Hospital ; owl:inverseOf :locatedInCity .

:locatedInCountry a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "located in country" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a city to a country." ; rdfs:domain :City ; rdfs:range :Country ; owl:inverseOf :hasCity .
:hasCity a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has city" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of locatedInCountry; relates a country to its cities." ; rdfs:domain :Country ; rdfs:range :City ; owl:inverseOf :locatedInCountry .

:hasUnionMembership a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has union membership" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a person to their union membership." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range :UnionMembership ; owl:inverseOf :membershipOf .
:membershipOf a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "membership of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasUnionMembership; relates a union membership to the person." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range :Person ; owl:inverseOf :hasUnionMembership .

:unionFor a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "union for" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a union membership to a union." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range :Union ; owl:inverseOf :hasMembership .
:hasMembership a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has membership" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of unionFor; relates a union to its memberships." ; rdfs:domain :Union ; rdfs:range :UnionMembership ; owl:inverseOf :unionFor .

:membershipRole a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "membership role" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a union membership to a union role." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range :UnionRole ; owl:inverseOf :roleOfMembership .
:roleOfMembership a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "role of membership" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of membershipRole; relates a union role to the union membership." ; rdfs:domain :UnionRole ; rdfs:range :UnionMembership ; owl:inverseOf :membershipRole .

:evaluatedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluated by" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an evaluation to the doctor who performed it." ; rdfs:domain :Evaluation ; rdfs:range :Doctor ; owl:inverseOf :performedEvaluation .
:performedEvaluation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "performed evaluation" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of evaluatedBy; relates a doctor to evaluations performed." ; rdfs:domain :Doctor ; rdfs:range :Evaluation ; owl:inverseOf :evaluatedBy .

:evaluatedEmployee a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluated employee" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an evaluation to the employee being evaluated." ; rdfs:domain :Evaluation ; rdfs:range :Employee ; owl:inverseOf :employeeEvaluation .
:employeeEvaluation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "employee evaluation" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of evaluatedEmployee; relates an employee to their evaluations." ; rdfs:domain :Employee ; rdfs:range :Evaluation ; owl:inverseOf :evaluatedEmployee .

:containsArticle a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contains article" ; rdfs:comment "Relates an article collection to articles it contains." ; rdfs:domain :ArticleCollection ; rdfs:range :Article ; owl:inverseOf :isContainedIn .
:isContainedIn a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is contained in" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of containsArticle; relates an article to the collection it is in." ; rdfs:domain :Article ; rdfs:range :ArticleCollection ; owl:inverseOf :containsArticle .

:seminarLocation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "seminar location" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a seminar to its location (hospital)." ; rdfs:domain :Seminar ; rdfs:range :Hospital ; owl:inverseOf :locationOfSeminar .
:locationOfSeminar a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "location of seminar" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of seminarLocation; relates a hospital to seminars held there." ; rdfs:domain :Hospital ; rdfs:range :Seminar ; owl:inverseOf :seminarLocation .

:presentedInSeminar a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "presented in seminar" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a seminar presentation to the seminar." ; rdfs:domain :SeminarPresentation ; rdfs:range :Seminar ; owl:inverseOf :hasPresentation .
:hasPresentation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has presentation" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of presentedInSeminar; relates a seminar to its presentations." ; rdfs:domain :Seminar ; rdfs:range :SeminarPresentation ; owl:inverseOf :presentedInSeminar .

:presentedArticle a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "presented article" ; rdfs:comment "Relates a seminar presentation to the article presented." ; rdfs:domain :SeminarPresentation ; rdfs:range :Article ; owl:inverseOf :articlePresentation .
:articlePresentation a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "article presentation" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of presentedArticle; relates an article to its seminar presentations." ; rdfs:domain :Article ; rdfs:range :SeminarPresentation ; owl:inverseOf :presentedArticle .

#################################################################
# Data Properties
#################################################################
:studyPeriod a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "study period" ; rdfs:comment "The period during which a person studied for a degree." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:employmentStartDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "employment start date" ; rdfs:comment "The date a person started employment at a hospital." ; rdfs:domain :Person ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:membershipStartDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "membership start date" ; rdfs:comment "The date a union membership began." ; rdfs:domain :UnionMembership ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:evaluationStatement a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "evaluation statement" ; rdfs:comment "The written evaluation statement." ; rdfs:domain :Evaluation ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:hasPages a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "has pages" ; rdfs:comment "The number of pages in a book." ; rdfs:domain :Book ; rdfs:range xsd:integer .
:publicationDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "publication date" ; rdfs:comment "The publication date of an article collection." ; rdfs:domain :ArticleCollection ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:seminarDate a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "seminar date" ; rdfs:comment "The date a seminar took place." ; rdfs:domain :Seminar ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .

#################################################################
# Restrictions & GCAs
#################################################################
# Each Seminar must have at least one SeminarPresentation linking to an Article
:Seminar rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :hasPresentation ; owl:someValuesFrom :SeminarPresentation ] .
:SeminarPresentation rdfs:subClassOf [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :presentedArticle ; owl:someValuesFrom :Article ] .

# An Employee is a Person employed at a Hospital
:Employee owl:equivalentClass [ a owl:Class ; owl:intersectionOf ( :Person [ a owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :employedAt ; owl:someValuesFrom :Hospital ] ) ] .
